description:
h2. Features Implementation

This epic covers the implementation of the following user stories:

h3. Enhancements
* Enhance User Engagement - Main Chat Interface
* Enhance User Experience - Settings Panel Configuration

h3. Features
* Improve User Efficiency - Quick Actions Toolbar

stories.summary: Enhance User Engagement - Main Chat Interface
stories.description:
h2. Business Value
I can efficiently communicate with the AI assistant and maintain a seamless conversation flow.

h2. User Story
As a regular user, I want to use the main chat interface with message history and input area so that I can efficiently communicate with the AI assistant and maintain a seamless conversation flow.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Implement a UI component for displaying message history with lazy loading for performance optimization.
* Develop a realtime messaging system to handle user inputs and AI responses.
* Ensure proper state management for maintaining message history and current input status.
* Integrate with existing AI assistant API for generating responses.
* Security:
* Implement security measures for data protection, including encryption of messages in transit.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The chat interface displays a scrollable message history that allows users to view past interactions.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The message input area is always visible and allows users to type and send messages with ease.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Messages are displayed in realtime, reflecting both user input and AI responses.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The interface is fully responsive, adapting to various screen sizes without losing functionality.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Error messages are displayed in case of failed message delivery, guiding the user to retry.
Then the system should respond appropriately

h2. Design References
* Main component: Main Chat Interface (1:0)

stories.summary: Enhance User Experience - Settings Panel Configuration
stories.description:
h2. Business Value
I can personalize my application experience according to my preferences and improve usability.

h2. User Story
As a returning user, I want to configure my language and theme settings so that I can personalize my application experience according to my preferences and improve usability.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Develop a UI component for the Settings Panel with 'Language Settings' and 'Theme Settings' options.
* Implement state management to handle user preferences persistently.
* Integrate with a localization service to support language changes.
* Ensure theme settings are applied globally with CSS or equivalent styling solutions.
* Implement error handling for failed save attempts and provide user feedback.
* Ensure the Settings Panel is responsive and functions correctly on various devices and screen sizes.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can access the Settings Panel from the main menu.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can select and save their preferred language from a predefined list.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Users can choose and apply a theme (light or dark mode) to the application.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Changes to language settings should automatically update all text within the application.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Theme changes should be reflected throughout the application immediately.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When Error messages are displayed if settings cannot be saved due to connectivity issues.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The Settings Panel must be accessible and comply with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
Then the system should respond appropriately

stories.summary: Improve User Efficiency - Quick Actions Toolbar
stories.description:
h2. Business Value
I can perform common tasks quickly and efficiently, enhancing my productivity.

h2. User Story
As a frequent application user, I want a Quick Actions toolbar with frequently used actions like 'Voice Input Toggle' and 'File Upload' so that I can perform common tasks quickly and efficiently, enhancing my productivity.

h2. Technical Requirements
* UI:
* Implement a responsive toolbar component that integrates 'Voice Input Toggle' and 'File Upload'.
* Ensure compatibility with existing state management to maintain the status of toggles.
* Performance:
* Optimize performance to handle frequent user interactions without noticeable delays.
* Security:
* Implement necessary security measures for file uploads, including validation and virus scanning.

h2. Acceptance Criteria
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The Quick Actions toolbar is accessible on all primary screens within the application.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The toolbar includes a functional 'Voice Input Toggle' that activates and deactivates voice input.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The toolbar includes a functional 'File Upload' button that allows users to select and upload files seamlessly.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# Given the user is on the relevant screen
When The toolbar is responsive and maintains usability across different device sizes.
Then the system should respond appropriately
# The toolbar provides feedback to the user when actions are successfully completed or if errors occur.

h2. Design References
